author: New China TV
description:
Why would young people in Kazakhstan choose to learn one of the world's most challenging languages?
For some, Chinese is a bridge to future opportunities. For others, it is a way to reconnect with their heritage or better understand a neighboring country.
Join journalist Kemar as he visits a Confucius Institute in Almaty and hears the personal stories behind students' passion for learning Chinese.
title: Belt and Road Explorer | Confucius Institute in Almaty: Why I'm fascinated by Chinese

author: New China TV
description:
What comes to mind when young people in Kazakhstan think of China?
Scholar Tatyana visited a Confucius Institute in Almaty to hear directly from students. From artificial intelligence and space exploration to education and future opportunities, their answers paint a picture of how a new generation views modern China.
Watch what they had to say.
title: Belt and Road Explorer | Confucius Institute in Almaty: How I see China in the new era
